title: General cycle and period characterization for NFSRs
summary: Characterize both the state cycles and output periods of every admissible nonlinear feedback shift register beyond known special families.

formal_statement.body: For every nonsingular binary nonlinear feedback shift register (NFSR), characterize both its state-cycle structure and the periods of its generated output sequences. A complete theorem or effective algorithm must cover every admissible feedback function, beyond the special Galois, F-Ring, symmetric, and other restricted classes already studied.

scope.domain: Binary nonsingular nonlinear feedback shift registers used in stream-cipher constructions
assumptions: The register is an NFSR over F_2
The output sequence follows the source's NFSR convention
scope.unresolved_remainder: Later inspected papers characterize only named special NFSR structures; no complete result covers both state cycles and output periods for every nonsingular NFSR.

citations.label: The Decomposition of Cascade Connections of NFSRs: Old and New Results

progress.summary: The source identifies general NFSR cycle structure and period characterization as open, with only special cases known.
